releaseNotes: Wall Types Preview is active directly from selected/imported profiles. Current and new colours, current/profile wall values, editable proposals and Parameter Presets-style status colours appear in the same window, followed by Apply checked or Discard. Wall identity values identify matches only and are not copied. Includes Arch 0.1.0.30 in one combined installer; unrelated binaries retained from beta.49. Native Revit apply/cancel/Undo acceptance pending. Save and close all Revit sessions before installing.
